scope: Proposition 2.16 (Postponed full-rank correction) of the manuscript “Strong diffeomorphic approximation in three dimensions for p>2” (preprints/Strong-diffeomorphic-approximation-in-three-dimensions-for-p-gt-2-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 368 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 824a96588feb42d5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 33. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let p > 2 and let f : Ω → Λ be an orientation- preserving Sobolev homeomorphism between bounded domains. Let R be the set of its regular differentiation points at which Df has rank three. Let P ⋐ Ω be any previously protected compact set disjoint from R. Given ε > 0, one can choose finitely many pairwise disjoint buffered source cubes, disjoint from P, with centers xj ∈ R, radii rj, and positive affine jets Aj = Df(xj), bj(x) = f(xj) + Aj(x − xj), such that the inner cubes Kj = xj + rjB satisfy Z R\ S j Kj |Df|p < ε, X j Z Kj |Df − Aj|p < ε. (2.36) Their buffered cutoff bands Ej = {xj + rjξ : |t(ξ)| ≤ Cs} can have arbitrarily small total f-energy, even after multiplication by all the finitely bounded affine factors Cp|Aj|p|A−1 j |p. On those bands the normalized f is within cs/4 of the identity. Write Qj = xj + rjB(C+1)s for the buffered outer cubes. After these choices there are numbers vj > 0 and β > 0 such that every smooth diffeomorphism k : Ω → Λ satisfying sup Qj |k − f| < vj for each j, X j Z Ej |Dk|p < β can be changed only inside the associated outer cubes xj + rjB2s to a locally bi-Lipschitz homeomor- phism e k : Ω → Λ with e k = bj on Kj. The sum of the derivative-error integrals on the inner cubes and their modified shells is less than ε, after starting the selection with smaller error prescriptions if necessary. The cubes and tests may also be chosen to retain any prescribed positive continuous value tolerance for the final modification. A locally bi-Lipschitz preliminary map in W1,p(Ω; R3) can be used in place of k by first applying Theorem A.1, preserving the finite value and band-energy tests with room to spare.
